description_en: Adds an SMB user to a file gateway
description_zh: 在文件网关添加一个SMB用户
name: CreateGatewaySMBUser

parameters.help_en: The username of the SMB user. The username must be 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: SMB用户名。长度限制1~32个字符，可以是英文、数字或符号中划线（-），下划线（_）
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The password of the SMB user. The password cannot be empty. The password can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: !, @, #, $, %, ^, &, and *
parameters.help_zh: SMB密码。密码不能为空，可以是英文、数字或符号："!","@","#","$","%","^","&","*"
parameters.name: password
